boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Beloit College
boards.description: Late-night dining options for Beloit College students, ranging from on-campus study breaks to local 24-hour convenience runs and late-night delivery favorites.

cards.title: Late-Night Study Breaks at Hamiltons
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Dining at the Powerhouse
cards.notes: Visit the Powerhouse for scheduled late-night study breaks featuring breakfast foods like pancakes, often served by college faculty and staff during finals week.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall located in the Powerhouse student union.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamiltons in the Powerhouse hosts late-night study breaks with breakfast food served at 9:00 PM during exam periods.
cards.source_title: Bon Appétit at Beloit College | Beloit WI - Facebook
cards.access_notes: Open for special late-night events until 11:00 PM or later; regular dinner ends at 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Grab-and-Go at DK's
cards.subtitle: Pearsons Hall Cafe
cards.notes: Stop by Pearsons Hall for late-evening snacks and smoothies. It serves as a convenient academic-side alternative to the main dining hall.
cards.short_summary: A casual cafe in Pearsons Hall offering grab-and-go food and smoothies.
cards.evidence_claim: DK's in Pearsons Hall is open until 8:00 PM Monday through Friday for general service.
cards.source_title: Campus Life & Community • Residential Life - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday until 8:00 PM.

cards.title: The 4 AM Riverside Run
cards.subtitle: 1841 Riverside Dr
cards.notes: Drive down Riverside Drive for late-night tacos and burritos. The drive-thru remains open until 4:00 AM daily for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night fast food destination located south of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 1841 Riverside Dr has drive-thru hours until 4:00 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Beloit, WI - 1841 Riverside Dr.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 4:00 AM; dining room closes at midnight.

cards.title: Late-Night Bites on State Street
cards.subtitle: 45 State St
cards.notes: Walk or drive to this nearby location for classic burgers and fries. It is one of the closest late-night options to the campus core.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food staple located just blocks from the Beloit College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 45 State St is open until 11:00 PM daily, with extended hours until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Beloit, WI at 45 State St | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Sun-Thu and 12:00 AM Fri-Sat.

cards.title: Late-Night Topperstix Delivery
cards.subtitle: Delivery to Campus
cards.notes: Order Topperstix or specialty pizzas for delivery directly to your dorm. They are a staple for late-night study sessions and weekend gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A regional pizza chain known for late-night delivery and signature cheesy bread.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers Pizza offers delivery in Beloit with late-night hours, typically until 2:00 AM or later on weekends.
cards.source_title: Toppers Pizza Delivery in Beloit, WI | Grubhub
cards.access_notes: Delivery available until 2:00 AM or later depending on the day.

cards.title: 24-Hour Breakfast at Perkins
cards.subtitle: 2787 Milwaukee Rd
cards.notes: Head to Milwaukee Road for a full sit-down breakfast at any hour. It is a classic destination for students looking for a late-night meal off-campus.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour American diner and bakery located a short drive from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Perkins Restaurant & Bakery on Milwaukee Road in Beloit is open 24 hours on weekends.
cards.source_title: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery in Beloit, WI
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours on Saturdays and Sundays; open until midnight on weekdays.

cards.title: The 24/7 Kwik Trip Run
cards.subtitle: 3155 Prairie Ave
cards.notes: Visit Kwik Trip for 24-hour access to hot food, snacks, and Glazers donuts. It is a reliable stop for students with cars at any time of night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and gas station offering a variety of fresh food.
cards.evidence_claim: Kwik Trip #1151 at 3155 Prairie Ave is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
cards.source_title: Kwik Trip (@KWIKTRIP1151) - Facebook
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Late-Night Pizza at Casey's
cards.subtitle: 1871 E Inman Pkwy
cards.notes: Pick up a famous Casey's pizza or grab snacks until 10:00 PM. While not 24 hours, it remains a popular evening stop for students in the area.
cards.short_summary: A convenience store known for its made-to-order pizza and evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Casey's at 1871 E Inman Pkwy is open until 10:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Pizza Delivery and Pickup in Beloit, WI | Casey's
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Evening Essentials at Walgreens
cards.subtitle: 910 Broad St
cards.notes: Walk to Broad Street for late-evening snacks, drinks, or pharmacy needs. It is a convenient downtown stop for students living near the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A pharmacy and retail store located in downtown Beloit near the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Walgreens at 910 Broad St is open until 8:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: 910 BROAD ST, Beloit, WI 53511 - Walgreens Pharmacy
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 8:00 PM.

cards.title: 24/7 Access at The Pantry
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Food Resource
cards.notes: Access free food and hygiene items at any time. This student-led resource ensures that no student goes hungry, regardless of the hour.
cards.short_summary: A free, 24/7 food and essentials resource for Beloit College students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pantry is a free service open to all Beloit College students, providing 24/7 access to donated food and hygiene items.
cards.source_title: Campus Life & Community • Residential Life - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for all Beloit College students.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student hubs and quiet corners of Beloit College, from high-tech media labs to historic campus landmarks used for modern study and social life.

cards.title: Riverside Lounge
cards.subtitle: The Powerhouse
cards.notes: Find soft seating and a quiet atmosphere overlooking the Rock River. It is a preferred spot for focused study away from the more active fitness and dining areas.
cards.short_summary: A quiet lounge with river views located on the second floor of the Powerhouse student center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Riverside Lounge in the Powerhouse offers soft seating and is used as a study space with views of the Rock River.
cards.source_title: Riverside Lounge • The Powerhouse - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open during Powerhouse operating hours; accessible to students via the third-floor bridge or main entrance.

cards.title: Grace's Place
cards.subtitle: Pearsons Hall Lower Level
cards.notes: Visit this community hub for social support and events. Named for Grace Ousley, it serves as a dedicated space for Black student life and inclusive programming.
cards.short_summary: A student-centered community space in Pearsons Hall dedicated to Black student life and belonging.
cards.evidence_claim: Grace's Place is located on the lower level of Pearsons Hall and serves as a center for services and programming for the Black community.
cards.source_title: Grace's Place - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Standard hours are Monday-Friday, 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM; reservations are required for group usage.

cards.title: Innovation Space
cards.subtitle: Morse Library
cards.notes: Record a podcast or edit digital animation in this tech-heavy lab. It provides professional-grade equipment for creative student projects beyond standard research.
cards.short_summary: A creative technology lab in Morse Library equipped for podcasting, film editing, and digital animation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Innovation Space in Morse Library has resources for digital animation, film editing, podcast recording, and video game programming.
cards.source_title: Library & Museums • Academics - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Morse Library hours; equipment can be checked out at the InfoDesk.

cards.title: Sanger Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: Sanger Center for the Sciences
cards.notes: Study among the crinoid fossils in this bright, multi-story space. It is a popular spot for students to gather between STEM classes or for evening study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A large, sunlit atrium in the science center featuring geological displays and student seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The atrium of the Sanger Center for the Sciences is used for student gatherings and displays the B.H. Beane Crinoid Collection.
cards.source_title: Collections and Equipment • Geology - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open daily during academic building hours; features ADA-accessible entry and elevators.

cards.title: DK's Café
cards.subtitle: Pearsons Hall
cards.notes: Grab a custom salad or wrap at this central campus eatery. It serves as the primary quick-service dining option for students on the academic side of campus.
cards.short_summary: A casual grab-and-go café in Pearsons Hall offering salads, wraps, and espresso drinks.
cards.evidence_claim: DK's Café in Pearsons Hall provides grab-and-go food options, espresso drinks, and a snack menu for students and faculty.
cards.source_title: Beloit College Invests in Student Experience with New Dining Facilities
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday; accepts student flex dollars and credit cards.

cards.title: Turtle Mound
cards.subtitle: Behind Wright Museum of Art
cards.notes: Observe the only effigy mound on campus, shaped like a turtle. It is a significant historical site that serves as the inspiration for the college's unofficial mascot.
cards.short_summary: A prehistoric Native American effigy mound located on the hill behind the Wright Museum of Art.
cards.evidence_claim: The Turtle Mound is the only effigy mound on campus and is located on the hill behind the Wright Museum of Art.
cards.source_title: Mounds and the Museum • Communications & Marketing - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor site accessible via campus walkways; visitors are asked to respect the site as a burial ground.

cards.title: Coughy Haus (C-Haus)
cards.subtitle: College and Clary Street
cards.notes: Attend a student-run concert or trivia night at this historic campus venue. While it serves as a bar, it is a primary social hub for all students aged 18 and older.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus music venue and social space hosting student-coordinated events and live music.
cards.evidence_claim: C-Haus is an on-campus music venue and bar that offers foosball, pool, and events like open mics and trivia nights.
cards.source_title: Coughy Haus (C-Haus) - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open Thursday-Saturday nights; entry requires being 18+ with a valid ID.

cards.title: Logan Museum of Anthropology
cards.subtitle: Godfrey Anthropology Building
cards.notes: Engage with over 200,000 artifacts in this teaching museum. Students use the collections for research, classwork, and even LARPing in anthropology courses.
cards.short_summary: A world-renowned anthropology museum that serves as a student laboratory and experiential learning center.
cards.evidence_claim: Beloit students have open access to the Logan Museum's artifacts for research, classwork, and LARPing as part of anthropology classes.
cards.source_title: Library & Museums • Academics - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open to the public Tuesday-Saturday; students have additional access for academic work.

cards.title: The Wall
cards.subtitle: Near Rock River
cards.notes: Play a pickup game at this outdoor basketball court located on the western edge of campus. It is a staple for student recreation near the riverfront.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor basketball court located near the Rock River and the Powerhouse.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beloit College campus map identifies 'The Wall' as a basketball court located near the Rock River.
cards.source_title: Flat Map 22_color_ceremony - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-access court; available during daylight hours.

cards.title: Wright Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Prospect and Bushnell Street
cards.notes: Curate exhibits or study the permanent collection of 6,000 works. This teaching museum allows students to gain hands-on experience in museum studies and art history.
cards.short_summary: A teaching museum where students assist in curating exhibits and researching a diverse art collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wright Museum of Art is a teaching museum where students assist in curating exhibits and researching wall texts.
cards.source_title: Wright Museum of Art - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Saturday, 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM; free admission for students and the public.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore Beloit College and the surrounding community with these social activities and spaces that require no admission fee or purchase.

cards.title: Logan Museum of Anthropology
cards.subtitle: Beloit College Campus
cards.notes: Explore global cultures through over 300,000 ethnographic and archaeological objects. Admission is free for all visitors during regular gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: A teaching museum of anthropology with free public admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Logan Museum of Anthropology offers free admission to the public and is located on the Beloit College campus.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information - Logan Museum of Anthropology - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday through Saturday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: Wright Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Beloit College Campus
cards.notes: View a permanent collection of 6,000 works and rotating student exhibitions. Entry to the galleries is free and open to the public.
cards.short_summary: Campus art museum featuring diverse collections with free entry.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wright Museum of Art is open to the public with free admission and features rotating exhibits.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information - Wright Museum of Art - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday through Saturday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: Beloit College Effigy Mounds
cards.subtitle: Beloit College Campus
cards.notes: Walk among 20 prehistoric Native American mounds, including the turtle-shaped mound that inspired the school mascot. The site is a free outdoor landmark.
cards.short_summary: Historic Native American earthworks located on the campus grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Beloit College campus features 20 unique animal-shaped effigy mounds that are accessible to the public for free.
cards.source_title: What the public can do at Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor site accessible during daylight hours.

cards.title: Riverside Park
cards.subtitle: Rock River Waterfront
cards.notes: Stroll the 3.5-mile paved River Walk or use the lighted tennis courts. This 23-acre park offers free admission and scenic views of the Rock River.
cards.short_summary: A large riverfront park with walking paths and recreational facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Riverside Park offers free admission and features the 3.5-mile Beloit River Walk and lighted tennis courts.
cards.source_title: Riverside Park Beloit | Travel Wisconsin
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset.

cards.title: The Powerhouse
cards.subtitle: Student Union & Recreation Center
cards.notes: Hang out in the common areas of this award-winning converted power plant. Students can access the indoor track and lounges without additional fees.
cards.short_summary: A repurposed power plant serving as a student union and fitness hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The Powerhouse is a student union and recreation center where students can hang out and use facilities like the track.
cards.source_title: The Powerhouse - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open weekdays 8 a.m. to 7 p.m., weekends 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.

cards.title: Big Hill Park
cards.subtitle: Rock River Bluffs
cards.notes: Hike the nature trails to reach the scenic overlook on the bluffs. This 190-acre park is free to enter and offers spectacular vistas of the river valley.
cards.short_summary: Scenic park on the bluffs with hiking trails and a river overlook.
cards.evidence_claim: Big Hill Park offers free admission and features nature trails and a scenic overlook.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Activities • The Powerhouse - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset.

cards.entity_name: Sanger Center for the Sciences Atrium
cards.title: Sanger Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: Science Center Hub
cards.notes: Study or meet friends in the four-story light-filled atrium. This central campus space is open for student use and features modern architecture.
cards.short_summary: A large, modern atrium inside the campus science center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sanger Center for the Sciences features a four-story atrium used for student gatherings and study.
cards.source_title: Atrium - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; security required for evening/weekend access.

cards.title: Morse Library
cards.subtitle: Campus Library
cards.notes: Utilize group study rooms or quiet carrels for collaborative work. The library provides various free academic environments for the college community.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering diverse study and research spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Morse Library provides group study rooms and carrels that are free for student use.
cards.source_title: Library Hours & Spaces - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; hours vary by day.

cards.entity_name: Dr. George W. Hilliard Park Disc Golf Course
cards.title: Hilliard Park Disc Golf
cards.subtitle: 9-Hole Course
cards.notes: Play a round of disc golf at this 9-hole course set among large oak trees. The course is free to the public and located in a nearby neighborhood park.
cards.short_summary: A free 9-hole disc golf course located in a local city park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dr. George W. Hilliard Park Disc Golf Course offers free admission for players.
cards.source_title: Dr. George W. Hilliard Park Disc Golf Course | Travel Wisconsin
cards.access_notes: Open during park hours, sunrise to sunset.

cards.title: Outdoor Art Trail
cards.subtitle: Citywide Sculpture Walk
cards.notes: Follow a self-guided tour of sculptures and murals throughout campus and downtown. This activity is free and highlights local artistic history.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided walking tour of public art installations in Beloit.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beloit & Beyond Outdoor Art Trail is a free self-guided activity featuring sculptures and art pieces.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Things To Do For Beloit College Students
cards.access_notes: Accessible anytime; best viewed during daylight hours.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: From the historic stacks of Morse Library to the industrial-chic lounges of the Powerhouse, these are the top environments for focused academic work at Beloit College.

cards.title: Morse Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Col. Robert H. Morse Library
cards.notes: Reserve these glass-walled rooms for collaborative projects. They feature large tables and whiteboards for group brainstorming sessions.
cards.short_summary: Reservable collaborative rooms located across all three levels of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Morse Library offers group study rooms on Levels 1, 2, and 3 that can be reserved through the college's reservation system.
cards.source_title: Library Hours & Spaces - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Monday-Thursday during the semester; Beloit ID required for entry after 6:00 PM.

cards.title: Riverside Lounge
cards.subtitle: The Powerhouse
cards.notes: Study with a view of the Rock River in this open lounge. The space features flexible furniture and a bright, industrial atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A scenic, open-concept study and gathering space located within the award-winning Powerhouse facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The Riverside Lounge in the Powerhouse has a capacity of 40 and allows food and drink, serving as an informal gathering and study space.
cards.source_title: Spaces • The Powerhouse - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Powerhouse building hours; students can drop in without a reservation for informal study.

cards.title: Sanger Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: Sanger Center for the Sciences
cards.notes: Find a spot at the tables in this four-story sunlit atrium. It is a popular hub for science students between lab sessions.
cards.short_summary: A bright, multi-level central atrium with seating areas designed for interdisciplinary interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sanger Center for the Sciences features a four-story atrium that provides a large area for receptions and informal study.
cards.source_title: Sanger Center for the Sciences - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; typically accessible to students for drop-in study.

cards.title: School of Business Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Pearsons Hall
cards.notes: Utilize this newly renovated lounge for focused business and economics coursework. It offers a modern, professional environment.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated collaborative space for business students located in the historic Daniel Burnham-designed Pearsons Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2025 renovation of Pearsons Hall established a dedicated home for the School of Business, featuring a new student lounge.
cards.source_title: Celebrating renovations to Pearsons Hall - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Students can book space in Pearsons Hall; the lounge is available for business-related study.

cards.title: Coleman Venture Lab
cards.subtitle: CELEB (Downtown)
cards.notes: Work on your startup or creative project at height-adjustable desks. This co-working space is equipped with high-end Macs and Alienware PCs.
cards.short_summary: A professional co-working office space for student entrepreneurs located in the downtown CELEB building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Coleman Venture Lab at CELEB is a co-working office space for students featuring communal tables and tech-equipped desks.
cards.source_title: Entrepreneurship Lab - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Located off-campus in downtown Beloit; open to all students regardless of major.

cards.title: Innovation Lab
cards.subtitle: Morse Library Level 1
cards.notes: Access high-performance computers with the Adobe Creative Suite for digital media projects. Ideal for film editing and graphic design.
cards.short_summary: A specialized tech lab in the library basement for students working on digital and creative media.
cards.evidence_claim: The Innovation Lab on Level 1 of Morse Library features high-performance computers with Adobe Creative Suite.
cards.source_title: Library Hours & Spaces - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Reservations can be made by emailing libref@beloit.edu; check library hours for availability.

cards.title: The Cube
cards.subtitle: Logan Museum of Anthropology
cards.notes: Study surrounded by thousands of artifacts in this glass-enclosed research space. It is one of the most unique academic settings on campus.
cards.short_summary: A visible storage and research facility where students can study amidst the museum's ceramic and basketry collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The interior of the Cube is used by students and faculty as a research, teaching, and consultation space.
cards.source_title: Visible Storage • Logan Museum of Anthropology - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Primarily used for research and teaching; students should contact museum staff for access to study within the Cube.

cards.title: Turbine Gallery
cards.subtitle: The Powerhouse
cards.notes: Choose a table in this expansive gallery for a more social study environment. It's close to Hamiltons for quick snack breaks.
cards.short_summary: A large, open event and gathering space that serves as a high-energy study spot near the main dining area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Citizens of Beloit Turbine Gallery in the Powerhouse is an event space that also allows food and drink for informal use.
cards.source_title: Spaces • The Powerhouse - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open during Powerhouse building hours; no reservation required for individual study at open tables.

cards.title: Archives Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Morse Library Room 127
cards.notes: Engage with primary sources in this quiet, protected environment. Perfect for history majors and those researching college lore.
cards.short_summary: A specialized, quiet room for students to work with rare documents and archival materials.
cards.evidence_claim: The Archives Reading Room (Room 127) provides a protected environment for working with archival materials.
cards.source_title: Library Hours & Spaces - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Contact the College Archivist to schedule a research consultation and access the room.

cards.title: Java Joint
cards.subtitle: Pearsons Hall
cards.notes: Grab a coffee and find a table in this classic campus cafe. It's a go-to spot for students who prefer background noise while they work.
cards.short_summary: A student-run coffee shop environment that doubles as a casual, high-traffic study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Java Joint is listed as a common 'drop in' space on campus for informal meetings and study.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Space • College Events - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open during cafe operating hours; check local postings for current semester schedule.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each

cards.title: State Street
cards.subtitle: Downtown Business District
cards.notes: Walk down this central corridor to find student favorites like Lucy's #7 Burger Bar and various local boutiques just blocks from the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A primary downtown commercial street featuring popular student dining and retail options.
cards.evidence_claim: State Street is home to Pizazz and Always & Forever Formal Wear, and is a central part of the downtown area frequented by students.
cards.source_title: Downtown Beloit Deals
cards.access_notes: Public street accessible 24/7; business hours vary.

cards.title: Grand Avenue
cards.subtitle: Riverfront Commercial Corridor
cards.notes: Cross the Rock River on this major thoroughfare to access the Beloit Public Library and scenic riverfront parks.
cards.short_summary: A major east-west street connecting the college area to the west side and riverfront amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Grand Avenue is a key downtown street mentioned in local guides and is home to the Grand Avenue Pub and other businesses.
cards.source_title: Getting Off Campus • Student Engagement & Leadership - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Public street accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Pleasant Street
cards.subtitle: Riverside Corridor
cards.notes: Follow this street along the Rock River to reach the Visit Beloit center and the start of the Riverside Park trails.
cards.short_summary: A scenic street running parallel to the Rock River, housing the local tourism office.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Beloit is located at 656 Pleasant Street, serving as a hub for local information.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Things To Do For Beloit College Students
cards.access_notes: Public street accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Broad Street
cards.subtitle: Downtown Retail Block
cards.notes: Visit this block for unique local shops like Bushel & Peck's Local Market, offering farm-to-table goods and a cafe atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A downtown street known for its local market and specialty retail shops.
cards.evidence_claim: Bushel & Peck's Local Market is a featured downtown destination for students.
cards.source_title: Downtown Beloit Deals
cards.access_notes: Public street accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Public Avenue
cards.subtitle: Campus-Downtown Link
cards.notes: This street serves as a direct pedestrian link between the main campus and the downtown commercial district.
cards.short_summary: A transition street connecting the historic college grounds with the city center.
cards.evidence_claim: Public Avenue is shown on campus maps as a primary route leading toward downtown.
cards.source_title: Flat Map 22_color_ceremony - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Public street accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Bushnell Street
cards.subtitle: Historic Residential Block
cards.notes: Walk past historic homes and the Bushnell Hall residence on this quiet street bordering the south side of campus.
cards.short_summary: A residential street featuring historic architecture and student housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Bushnell Hall is an all-female identifying residence hall located on Bushnell Street.
cards.source_title: Upper-level Student Housing • Residential Life - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Public residential street.

cards.title: College Street
cards.subtitle: Main Campus Thoroughfare
cards.notes: This street bisects the campus and is the location of 'The Wall,' the college's most famous informal meeting spot.
cards.short_summary: The central street running through the heart of the Beloit College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wall is located at the corner of College and Clary streets and is a primary campus landmark.
cards.source_title: The Best Spots on Campus • Admissions - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Public street through campus.

cards.title: Prospect Street
cards.subtitle: Eastern Campus Border
cards.notes: This street marks the eastern edge of the main campus, providing access to several academic buildings and green spaces.
cards.short_summary: A north-south street defining the eastern boundary of the college grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Prospect Street is a boundary street shown on the official Beloit College campus map.
cards.source_title: Flat Map 22_color_ceremony - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Public street accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Park Avenue
cards.subtitle: Residential and Institutional Corridor
cards.notes: Travel north on this street to find local parks and residential neighborhoods popular for upperclassman off-campus living.
cards.short_summary: A long north-south avenue bordering the campus and extending into residential Beloit.
cards.evidence_claim: Park Avenue is a major street bordering the campus, as indicated on the college's flat map.
cards.source_title: Flat Map 22_color_ceremony - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Public street accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Clary Street
cards.subtitle: Residential Housing Block
cards.notes: Home to the Clary Street Apartments, this block is a hub for upper-level student life and campus shuttles.
cards.short_summary: A street on the north side of campus primarily known for student apartment housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Clary Street Apartments provide co-ed upperclassmen housing on the edge of the residential side of campus.
cards.source_title: Upper-level Student Housing • Residential Life - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; shuttle stop located at the corner of College and Clary.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing customs that define the Beloit College experience, from ancient mounds to musical festivals.

cards.title: Spring Day
cards.subtitle: A Spontaneous Break from Classes
cards.notes: Celebrate the arrival of warm weather with a surprise day off. Students gather on Chapin Quad for music, food trucks, and the Holi Festival of Colors.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring tradition where classes are canceled for a day of outdoor festivities and community celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Spring Day is an enduring Beloit College tradition since the 1970s where classes are canceled to celebrate warmer April weather with outdoor picnics and music.
cards.source_title: Fridays with Fred - Spring Day - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually in April; specific date is announced spontaneously by the college administration.

cards.title: The Turtle Mound
cards.subtitle: Sacred Ground and Unofficial Mascot
cards.notes: Visit the ancient effigy mound behind the Wright Museum. Out of respect for its sacred nature, students are encouraged to observe without walking on it.
cards.short_summary: A 1,000-year-old Native American effigy mound that serves as the inspiration for Beloit's unofficial turtle mascot.
cards.evidence_claim: The turtle-shaped effigy mound behind the Wright Museum of Art inspired the college's unofficial mascot and is a sacred space stewarded by the Ho-Chunk Nation.
cards.source_title: Mounds and the Museum • Logan Museum of Anthropology
cards.access_notes: Accessible year-round; visitors must remain off the mounds to preserve their structural and spiritual integrity.

cards.title: Folk 'n' Blues Festival
cards.subtitle: Beloit's Longest-Running Music Fest
cards.notes: Join the campus for a weekend of live music on Chapin Quad. This student-run festival has hosted legendary acts since its founding in 1972.
cards.short_summary: An annual music festival featuring a mix of folk, blues, and contemporary genres, organized by the student Programming Board.
cards.evidence_claim: The Folk 'n' Blues Festival is a tradition rooted in Beloit history, starting in 1972 when students invited Chicago-based artists to perform on Chapin Quad.
cards.source_title: Roots run deep at Folk 'n' Blues Festival - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the fall; open to students and the local community.

cards.title: The Senior Bench
cards.subtitle: A Gift from the Class of 1908
cards.notes: Look for the limestone bench near Eaton Chapel. Traditionally, only seniors are permitted to sit here, a privilege handed down at Spring Convocation.
cards.short_summary: A historic limestone bench that serves as a symbolic seat of honor reserved exclusively for the senior class.
cards.evidence_claim: The Senior Bench, a gift from the class of 1908, stands near Eaton Chapel and is traditionally reserved for seniors to sit on.
cards.source_title: Fridays with Fred: A photographic essay of the college in the teens
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors near the north side of Eaton Chapel; accessible to all for viewing.

cards.title: Blue Skies Award
cards.subtitle: Celebrating Good Cheer
cards.notes: Watch for the presentation of this whimsical award at Commencement. It honors a student who brings infectious positivity and humor to campus life.
cards.short_summary: A unique graduation honor given to a student who exemplifies good humor and improves the quality of life on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Warren Miller Blue Skies Award, established in 1982, recognizes a student for fostering good cheer and a good-humored perspective on campus.
cards.source_title: Blue Skies and Beyond • Beloit College Magazine
cards.access_notes: Awarded annually during the Commencement ceremony in May.

cards.title: International Gala
cards.subtitle: A Global Cultural Showcase
cards.notes: Experience a night of global fashion, music, and cuisine. This event highlights the diverse backgrounds of Beloit's international student body.
cards.short_summary: An annual celebration of global cultures featuring student performances, a fashion show, and international food.
cards.evidence_claim: The International Gala is a campus-wide celebration honoring culture and global community through music, fashion, and international cuisine.
cards.source_title: Beloit College International Gala 2025
cards.access_notes: Typically held in November during International Education Week at the Powerhouse.

cards.title: New Student Days
cards.subtitle: The Buccaneer Welcome
cards.notes: Kick off your college journey with orientation activities designed to build community and introduce new students to campus traditions.
cards.short_summary: A multi-day orientation program for incoming students to connect with mentors and learn about Beloit's unique culture.
cards.evidence_claim: New Student Days is where the Beloit College journey begins, allowing students to meet mentors and learn Buccaneer traditions before classes start.
cards.source_title: Fall Semester Checklist • New Buccaneers - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in August for all incoming first-year and transfer students.

cards.title: The Round Table
cards.subtitle: Wisconsin's Oldest Student Newspaper
cards.notes: Pick up a copy of the student-run paper. Founded in 1853, it has documented campus life and student activism for over 170 years.
cards.short_summary: The historic student newspaper of Beloit College, known for its independent journalism and long-standing presence on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Round Table is the oldest student newspaper in Wisconsin, with its inaugural issue published in 1853.
cards.source_title: Print is Dying. - The Round Table
cards.access_notes: Available at various distribution points across campus during the academic year.

cards.title: Student Symposium
cards.subtitle: Showcasing Liberal Arts in Practice
cards.notes: Attend presentations where students share their research and internship experiences. It's a day dedicated to celebrating academic achievement.
cards.short_summary: An annual event where students present their independent research, creative projects, and field experiences to the community.
cards.evidence_claim: During the spring's Student Symposium, students share their research, internship, and study abroad experiences with the college community.
cards.source_title: Student Life - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the spring semester; open to the public.

cards.title: Winterfest
cards.subtitle: Embracing the Wisconsin Winter
cards.notes: Enjoy the snow with activities like horse-drawn sleigh rides and ice skating. This event turns the campus into a winter wonderland for students.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal celebration featuring traditional winter activities and community-building events on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Winterfest is an annual event that celebrates winter with indoor and outdoor activities like horse-drawn sleigh rides and ice skating.
cards.source_title: Beloit College Winter Wonderland
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the winter months, typically December or February.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Beloit College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Check-In and Key Pickup
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Start your journey at Pearsons Hall to collect your room keys and student ID. This historic building serves as the central hub for student services and initial orientation steps.
cards.short_summary: The central administrative hub where new students pick up keys and IDs.
cards.evidence_claim: New student check-in and key pickup occurs at Pearsons Hall during orientation days.
cards.source_title: Campus Life & Community • Residential Life - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open during business hours for orientation check-in; student ID required for most services.

cards.title: First Meal at the Powerhouse
cards.subtitle: Friday Lunch
cards.notes: Head to the Powerhouse for lunch at Hamiltons. It is the main dining hall and a great spot to meet fellow new students in a converted historic power plant.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall located within the Powerhouse student center.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamiltons in the Powerhouse is the main dining hall serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
cards.source_title: The Powerhouse - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Meal plan or payment required; open daily during the semester.

cards.title: Reflect at the Turtle Mound
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Walk
cards.notes: Visit the ancient turtle-shaped effigy mound behind the Wright Museum. It is a sacred site and the inspiration for the college's unofficial mascot.
cards.short_summary: An ancient Native American effigy mound that serves as a central campus landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The turtle-shaped effigy mound is located behind the Wright Museum of Art and is a key campus landmark.
cards.source_title: Beloit College Mound Group • Logan Museum of Anthropology
cards.access_notes: Outdoor site accessible 24/7; visitors are asked to remain off the mounds to preserve them.

cards.title: Explore Global Cultures
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning
cards.notes: Spend your Saturday morning browsing the Logan Museum's extensive collections. It is a teaching museum where students often lead the curation of exhibits.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum housing significant anthropological and archaeological collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Logan Museum of Anthropology is open Tuesday-Saturday, 11:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information - Logan Museum of Anthropology - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Saturday 11am-4pm; free for students and the public.

cards.title: Grab a Snack at DK's
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon
cards.notes: Stop by DK's in Pearsons Hall for a quick snack or coffee. It's a popular casual spot for students to refuel between orientation activities.
cards.short_summary: A casual cafe and snack bar located in Pearsons Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: DK's in Pearsons Hall offers casual cafe and grab-and-go food options.
cards.source_title: Dining • Student Life - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open daily; accepts meal plan flex dollars and credit cards.

cards.title: Walk Along the Rock River
cards.subtitle: Saturday Evening
cards.notes: Take a short walk from campus to Riverside Park. Enjoy the scenic river views and paved paths that connect the college to the broader Beloit community.
cards.short_summary: A large city park adjacent to campus featuring riverfront trails and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Riverside Park is located near campus and offers bike and walking paths connected to the Powerhouse.
cards.source_title: Wellness & Recreation • Student Life - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: View the Plaster Casts
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning
cards.notes: Visit the Wright Museum to see its famous collection of plaster casts from the 1893 World's Fair. It's a quiet place for artistic inspiration.
cards.short_summary: The college's art museum featuring a diverse permanent collection and rotating exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wright Museum of Art is open Tuesday-Saturday 11am-4pm; it houses a collection of plaster casts.
cards.source_title: Wright Museum of Art - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Saturday 11am-4pm; free admission.

cards.title: Find Your Study Nook
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon
cards.notes: Scope out the best study spots in Morse Library before classes begin. The recently renovated first floor offers modern collaborative spaces.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library providing research resources and varied study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: Morse Library is the primary library on campus with spaces for reading and studying.
cards.source_title: Col. Robert H. Morse Library - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Student ID required for entry after 6:00 p.m.

cards.title: Evening Workout or Swim
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening
cards.notes: End your weekend with a workout or a swim in the competition pool at the Powerhouse. It's the best way to burn off pre-class jitters.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art fitness and recreation facility for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Powerhouse features a fitness floor, 8-lane pool, and indoor track for student use.
cards.source_title: Fitness • The Powerhouse - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Student ID required for access; bring clean shoes for the fitness floor.

cards.title: The Convocation March
cards.subtitle: Monday Morning Tradition
cards.notes: Join the formal march down College Street following Convocation. This tradition marks the official start of your academic career at Beloit.
cards.short_summary: A traditional ceremonial march by new students to celebrate the start of the year.
cards.evidence_claim: Convocation is followed by a celebratory march down College Street for new students.
cards.source_title: Pomp and revelry welcome new students (again) - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Public street; event occurs annually on the first day of classes.
